page.notes: The ink blot over "Tridenti" in line 8 hides about two letters (the "ni" of Tridentini); marked as illegible. The "&" before "contra" in line 9 sits near the blot but is readable. The word "auc" at the end of line 18 is the printed form and is doubtful; the hyphenation of "Auctò-res" at the end of line 22 is also doubtful. The page number "595" at top right is partly blurred at the last digit. A small stray stroke at top left and faint digitiser text at bottom right are not printed text and are left out.
